title: Geostationary Full-Disk Imagery
description:
This repo contains full-disk geostationary imagery from GOES/Himawari/G2-KA in icechunk format, converted from the public AWS archives. The data is processed by Satpy, and is the L1b data. 

The datasets are very incomplete, but the goal is to slowly add more historical imagery as time allows, as well as near-real time.
